countries/bolivia.summary: Bolivia's currency crisis deepened: the boliviano lost as much as 76% of its value in the roughly three months since the government floated the exchange rate on 26 June 2026 (moving from a peg of 6.96/USD to as high as 9.73/USD). On 9 September the central bank injected US$35 million of its dwindling reserves into the market -- an emergency intervention described as necessary to 'mitigate unnecessary volatility' -- and separately began offering dollars directly to banks. This follows the state of emergency declared in June over anti-government protests tied to the economic crisis (24 deaths recorded by July).

countries/brazil.summary: An institutional crisis at Brazil's Supreme Court (STF) escalated after Justice Andre Mendonca lifted confidentiality on messages between Justice Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro (1 September). On 8 September Mendonca ordered preventive removal of Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues; on 9 September Justice Flavio Dino ordered his immediate reinstatement. The Court cancelled sessions on consecutive days amid allegations of graft, political bias and police interference among sitting justices, with the turmoil spilling into the October general election and right-wing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro reportedly overtaking President Lula in one poll (8 September).
